title: Retirement Official's Home Raid Uncovers Large Cache of Gold and Cash
summary: A raid on the home of a retired assistant sub-divisional transport officer (ARTO) in Lucknow has uncovered a large cache of gold, cash, and other valuables. The official, Lalit Kumar, is accused of amassing wealth beyond his means through corrupt means.
summary_points: The raid was conducted at the home of Lalit Kumar, a retired ARTO from Lucknow.
A large amount of gold, including 13 kg, and cash, totaling ₹1.62 crore, were found during the raid.
Kumar is accused of amassing wealth beyond his means through corrupt means.
The incident has raised questions about corruption among government officials in India.
An investigation into Kumar's past is ongoing to determine the extent of his alleged wrongdoing.
